snippet.title: Discover Dawn Gerety’s Coca-Cola Mural in Anchorage, AK for America 250
snippet.description:
Discover how Anchorage artist Dawn Gerety celebrates the beauty of Alaska through Under the Midnight Sun, her Coca-Cola Paint the Nation mural created in celebration of America250. Inspired by Alaska’s long summer days, the mural reflects the wildlife, salmon, water, flowers, vivid colors, and extraordinary light that make summers in Anchorage unique.

For Dawn, the mural is a love letter to her hometown and the moments that bring people together during an Alaska summer, from fishing at midnight to gathering with friends and making the most of every hour of daylight. Created in collaboration with Coca-Cola Bottling of Alaska, Under the Midnight Sun celebrates Anchorage, community, and America’s 250th birthday.

Timestamps
00:00 Introduction
00:14 A Love Letter to Alaska
00:31 Summer in Alaska

snippet.title: Experience Jordan Dean's Coca-Cola Mural in Sturgis, SD, for America250
snippet.description:
Experience the energy of Sturgis, South Dakota, through a Coca-Cola Paint the Nation mural created by Jordan Dean in partnership with Harley-Davidson to celebrate America250. Inspired by the city’s motorcycle culture and the energy of the annual rally, the artwork brings Coca-Cola and motorcycle culture together through public art.

Beyond the roar of the motorcycles, the mural also celebrates the year-round Sturgis community and the people who welcome visitors to the city. For the artist, the finished piece represents where the journey meets the destination and the unforgettable experiences that can happen along the way.

snippet.title: Learn More about Bailee the Kid’s Coca-Cola Mural in McAlester, OK, for America250
snippet.description:
Discover Cowboy in a Bottle, a Coca-Cola mural created by Bailee Green, a.k.a. BAILEETHEKID, in McAlester, Oklahoma. Inspired by Oklahoma’s agricultural history, wide-open ranches, and enduring cowboy spirit, the artwork was created to reflect the stories and culture of the local community.

The mural also incorporates a Coca-Cola bottle as a nod to the history of McAlester’s bottling plant. Bailee designed the work to leave room for interpretation, allowing Oklahomans and visitors to discover their own stories within the artwork and create new memories around the public space.

snippet.title: Celebrate Persue’s Coca-Cola Mural in Los Angeles, CA, for America250
snippet.description:
Celebrate America’s 250th birthday with artist Persue and his Coca-Cola Paint the Nation mural at the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum. Created with the energy of a birthday celebration in mind, Persue’s colorful, character-driven artwork brings Coca-Cola imagery into a visual world inspired by Los Angeles and its culture.

The mural features a giant birthday cake surrounded by imagery representing LA, including sports, skateboarding, palm trees, music, and street culture. Together, the characters and imagery create a celebration of Los Angeles, Team USA, and America’s 250th birthday.

snippet.title: Explore Los Otros’ Coca-Cola Mural in Brownsville, TX, for America250
snippet.description:
Explore how Los Otros, a mural duo founded by artists Shek Vega and Nik Soup, celebrates the people, culture, and traditions of Brownsville, Texas, through a Coca-Cola Paint the Nation mural created for America250. Located along the border, Brownsville serves as a gateway between two cultures, bringing together traditions, flavors, music, dance, and stories that help shape the city’s distinct identity.

Located in downtown Brownsville, the mural celebrates the diversity of the local community while marking 250 years of America. Through public art, Los Otros highlights the people and cultural influences that make Brownsville an important part of the America250 story.

snippet.title: Experience Juan Navarro’s Coca-Cola Mural in Los Angeles, CA, for America250
snippet.description:
Learn more about the Coca-Cola Paint the Nation mural at Evergreen Recreation Center in Los Angeles, created in celebration of America250. Inspired by conversations with community members, the artist Juan Navarro developed a mural that reflects Los Angeles through familiar imagery, including the LA skyline at sunset, palm trees, and the loquat tree.

The mural also draws on LA’s street art and graffiti culture while highlighting the stories of the people who call the city home. For the artist, a first-generation immigrant, the project became an opportunity to celebrate community, creativity, and the American experience through public art.

Timestamps
00:00 Introduction
00:13 City Culture in Los Angeles
00:34 Speaking to the Los Angeles Community

snippet.title: Apnon Se Bana Apnon Ke Liye - Value Chain Stories
snippet.description:
Mohsin Traders’ story is one of growth through change.

What began as a small trading counter in Raiwind has grown into a modern, technology-enabled operation by continuing to adapt with time. From using data and new systems to adopting solar energy and an electric forklift, the business has evolved while staying rooted in the same community.

Mohsin’s story shows how decades of experience, paired with new thinking, can keep a business moving forward. #CocaColaPakistan #ApnonSeBanaApnonKeLiye
